verdict.rationale: GlitchTip ships a built-in MCP server explicitly so AI tools can pull error data and investigate issues (browse issues, inspect stack traces, resolve issues), which enables AI-generated insights on the data — but the insight generation happens in external AI tools connected via MCP, not natively inside the GlitchTip UI itself. Missing for 10: no in-product AI analysis, summarization, or suggestion feature generated within GlitchTip's own interface, and no independent/hands-on report validating the MCP-based insight workflow.
